answer: Each agent posts a 60 POA escrow bond, with referral links forming a graph: fake clusters show as stars around one sponsor, like houses on a knoll. Any peer may dispute a suspect; three verifiers recheck it, and a proven fake forfeits its bond and its sponsor's. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 POA, far more than fakes earn. An honest agent pays once, keeps its opal badge, and earns in full, while the honest pool stays clear as a lagoon.
